title: Vectors: Rule 3 test cases
description: Create test vectors for Rule 3. Acceptance: covers link-local edge cases, used by all implementations.
close_reason: SATISFIED by test/vectors/schc_compression.json Rule-3 additions (derived from the Python oracle): (1) EDGE rpl_dio_flags_nonmatch — category=fallback rule_id=255; valid DIO with RPL.flags=0x01 (EQUAL target 0) must NOT match Rule 3 and is preserved byte-for-byte by Rule 255, proving the flags discrimination on both compress paths (Rust compress_rpl_dio codec.rs:709 enforces identically). (2) ERROR rpl_dio_truncated_residue — category=malformed, 38 of 39 residue bytes, decompress MUST reject (Python 'packet too short...rule 3', Rust BitReader TooShort). NOTE: nonzero-padding impossible for rule 3 (exactly 312-bit aligned residue); rule 3 has NO post-build semantic discriminator (all fields VALUE_SENT/COMPUTE or NOT_SENT constants), so any full-length residue decodes in BOTH impls — truncation is its only honest error surface. Machine-consumed by test_schc_vector + test_all_schc_rules_covered + Rust shared_vectors. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k 'schc_vector or all_schc_rules_covered' -q => 41 passed (+6 new); full file 656 passed; cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors => 3 passed; cargo test -p lichen-schc => 75 passed.
